response: Lanny Flaherty is an American actor born on December 18, 1949, in Pensacola, Florida. His career began in the late 1970s, and he appeared in numerous films, television shows, and theater productions. He is known for his deep gravelly voice. Born in 1942, Flaherty was a Mississippi native who first appeared on screen only in the 1990s. Critics often described the British character actor for his soft, high-pitched voice, which made him instantly recognizable.
